description: The South Galactic Cap u-band Sky Survey (SCUSS) was a deep optical photometric survey covering about 5,000 square degrees in the southern Galactic cap, using the 90Prime prime-focus imager on the Bok 2.3-meter telescope.
facility_description: The 2.3-meter Bok Telescope on Kitt Peak is operated by Steward Observatory, University of Arizona.
notes: SCUSS utilized a dedicated high-throughput u-band filter on 90Prime at the Bok telescope. Survey data and profiles were prepared under NAOC and Steward collaboration; redistribution terms for raw profile files are not explicitly released under an open copyright license.

The project is managed by the National Astronomical Observatory of China and Shanghai Astronomical Observatory.
